summary: Frontend UI batch verification for artirdim.com. All 8 requested features tested: SPA auth links, light-mode logo centering, message-seller SPA, header-search SPA, messages page width, profile story play, home story viewer (animated progress + cross-user next), and auction card skeleton/img-ready. All pass; two very minor observations noted around story auto-advance timing and close-button responsiveness after cross-user navigation.

integration_issues.flow: Story viewer close after cross-user navigation
integration_issues.issue: After clicking .story-next to advance to another user's story, a subsequent click on data-testid=story-close did not always dismiss the viewer within 500ms. Needs re-verification; may be timing/re-render race. Non-blocking.

After ~6s the img.src slice appeared unchanged in DOM sample. Progress bar animation is correctly set (animation: '5s linear forwards storyFill'). Could be same-avatar seeded story path collision, but recommend main agent verify auto-advance actually fires the onAnimationEnd handler.

verified_features.auth_spa_links: PASS — login->forgot, login->register, register->login, forgot->login all preserve window.__spa='alive'
verified_features.auth_logo_centered_light: PASS — elCenter=359.49, parentCenter=359.50 (delta ~0), html.light-mode active, screenshot captured
verified_features.header_search_spa: PASS — .search-result-item click navigates to /u/buyer with __spa preserved
verified_features.messages_page_width: PASS — .msg-page computed max-width: 1400px (rendered 1115px inside sidebar layout)
verified_features.profile_stories_play: PASS — profile-avatar-story opens story-viewer, image loaded, 2 progress bars including .sp-fill-active
verified_features.home_story_viewer: PASS (partial) — 6 users in story-bar, skeleton shown briefly, image loads, .sp-fill-active with animation '5s linear forwards storyFill', .story-next changes image (cross-user works)
verified_features.auction_card_skeleton: PASS — 24/24 cards have .idx-card-img.img-ready and 24/24 imgs have .loaded class after home load

action_items: Re-verify story auto-advance fires after 5s (progress bar animationend -> next story) — animation styling is correct but src did not visibly change in one sample (may be seed-data coincidence).
Re-verify data-testid=story-close reliability immediately after cross-user navigation.
critical_code_review_comments: Console shows repeated 403s on notifications/heartbeat polling — expected per request, but consider suppressing/backing-off to reduce log noise.
Search dropdown returns quickly (~1.2s) and works via router.visit — good.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SPA verification pattern: set window.__spa='alive' before click, then check preserved after navigation. Auction slugs are dynamic — grab first href from /browse/auctions instead of guessing (e.g., laravel-dev-16 subdomain is NOT an auction slug). Login submit works via form.requestSubmit() reliably (button 'Giriş Yap' text-click can be flaky).
